result.keywords: This fictional article examines a non-agricultural planning framework for allocating reclaimed water across rooftop habitats in dense coastal districts. It proposes a symbolic ledger model for balancing shade, evaporation, and maintenance schedules in municipal microclimate design. The study is presented as a conceptual architecture paper rather than a robotics, software, or crop-sensing contribution, and it emphasizes civic infrastructure, environmental bookkeeping, and nighttime resource routing.
result.title: Lattice Gardens for Night-Shift Water Accounting.
